description: This Java class contains integration tests (indicated by 'IT' suffix) for the ThingPersistenceOperationsActor, testing persistence and retrieval operations with a local MongoDB. It uses JUnit for testing and Akka actors framework for actor system management.

classes.name: ThingPersistenceOperationsActorIT
classes.description: Integration test class for the ThingPersistenceOperationsActor, extending MongoEventSourceITAssertions to test MongoDB-backed persistence operations for 'things'.

methods.name: purgeNamespace
methods.description: A test method that invokes namespace purging to ensure clean state before or after tests.

methods.name: getServiceName
methods.description: Returns the service name 'things' used in test context.

methods.name: getResourceType
methods.description: Provides the resource type constant used for command identification.

methods.name: toEntityId
methods.description: Converts an EntityId to a specific ThingId.

methods.name: getCreateEntityCommand
methods.description: Creates a command object to create a new Thing entity.

methods.name: getCreateEntityResponseClass
methods.description: Returns the class of the expected response for create operations.

methods.name: getRetrieveEntityCommand
methods.description: Creates a command object to retrieve an existing Thing entity.

methods.name: getRetrieveEntityResponseClass
methods.description: Returns the class of the expected response for retrieve operations.

methods.name: getEntityNotAccessibleClass
methods.description: Returns the exception class used when a Thing entity is inaccessible.

methods.name: startActorUnderTest
methods.description: Initializes and starts the Actor under test, setting up the necessary actor system components.

methods.name: startEntityActor
methods.description: Starts an entity actor (Thing) with specific identifiers and pub/sub mediator.
